items.title: Millions lose access to benefits and pensions services after 'cyber incident'
items.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions says some of its services have been take offline as a precaution.

items.title: 'Monster' jailed for coercing children into acts of violence and sexual activity online
items.summary: A man who was part of an organised crime group that blackmailed and distributed indecent images of children has been jailed for 14 and a half years.

items.title: 'I wouldn't be here today without you': Student's praise for man who stopped train attacker
items.summary: Astrid credits Stephen Crean with saving her life during the Huntingdon train attack last year.

items.title: Police seek 100 concertgoers over mass evacuation at Manchester rap gig
items.summary: A "small group of organised criminals" are being sought by police after an unknown substance sparked a mass evacuation at a Manchester concert.

items.title: Police look for more than 100 gig-goers to help Co-op Live probe
items.summary: Rap fans say people were "choking" and "coughing up blood" towards the end of Don Toliver's gig.

items.title: Kenyan cult leader in jail for 191 murders convicted over another 123 deaths
items.summary: A Kenyan cult leader has been convicted of manslaughter over the deaths of 123 of his followers, having already been found guilty of murdering 191 others.
